goalie-line-every-game.note: Kept in every story (Sora, 2026-10-17), but a losing goalie 1.0+ goals above expected now "kept them in it", and a winner who faced 18 or fewer shots and allowed one or none "needed only N saves".

ended-streak-vs-opponent.note: An ended point streak against one club is told only from seven games (one that goes on still from five).

preview-form-bare.note: A team with no streak to tell gets its record and last result; a last game against tonight's opponent is left to the meetings sentence (it was told twice on WPG at FLA).

preview-story-echoes-calls.note: The matchup sentence now names both groups. The other call summaries still repeat the cards below them: proposal.

busy-period-filler.note: "It was a busy second period" is Sora's own line (CAR at CHI); each wording is already used once a story.

didnt-score-again.note: Sora asked for the story to say when a team's scoring stopped (review, round 2). Variety could still improve: proposal.

lineup-projection-item.note: Sora asked for these (2026-10-16). Proposal: only when a regular or a star is involved.

lead-not-the-story.note: Needs Sora: hot opening lines are limited to 3-goal comebacks, goalie-pulled ties that won and 6-goal routs (2026-10-14). Proposal: a plain one-line lead naming the game's shape.

standings-pair-template.note: Proposal: one sentence for both clubs when neither took a place from the other.

goal-by-goal-in-routs.note: Proposal: three or more unanswered goals in a decided game as one sentence naming the scorers.
